qa_pairs.instruction: In the Delimited Text driver, what problem occurs if I perform a bulk removal of resource assignments from the User Application without stopping the driver first?
qa_pairs.output: In the Delimited Text driver, if you perform a bulk removal of resource assignments from the User Application without stopping the driver first, the driver creates multiple user entries in the output CSV file instead of a single consolidated entry. This issue may also display a warning message when deploying the driver for the first time.

qa_pairs.instruction: How should I perform bulk revocations of resource assignments in the Delimited Text driver to avoid creating multiple entries in the output CSV file?
qa_pairs.output:
To avoid creating multiple entries in the output CSV file when performing bulk revocations in the Delimited Text driver:

1. Stop the Delimited Text driver before performing the bulk removal of resource assignments from the User Application.
2. Complete the bulk revocations.
3. Restart the driver.

This procedure ensures the output CSV file contains one entry per user instead of multiple intermediate entries.

qa_pairs.instruction: Why does the Delimited Text driver require stopping before bulk resource assignment operations?
qa_pairs.output: The Delimited Text driver requires stopping before bulk resource assignment operations (specifically bulk removals) to prevent the creation of multiple user entries in the output CSV file. Without stopping the driver, each intermediate change during the bulk operation may be written as a separate entry, resulting in duplicate or multiple entries for the same user. Stopping and restarting the driver allows it to consolidate the changes into a single entry per user in the output CSV file.

qa_pairs.instruction: When deploying the Delimited Text driver for the first time, what warning might appear related to bulk assignment operations?
qa_pairs.output: When deploying the Delimited Text driver for the first time, a warning message might appear related to the issue of multiple user entries being created in the output CSV file during bulk removal of resource assignments. This warning alerts administrators to stop the driver before performing such bulk operations to avoid creating multiple intermediate entries in the output file.
